name: Test Environments
description: Launch projects, select real accounts, prepare samples, run acceptance cases and stop. Remember app-owned login profiles separately on each computer.
whenToUse: Launch projects, select real accounts, prepare samples, run acceptance cases and stop. Remember app-owned login profiles separately on each computer.

catalog.description: List projects, real account references with local profile history, launch profiles and acceptance cases. No credentials. A listed account is not proof of a valid login.

save_project.description: Save a project and its argv commands. Commands execute as this computer user. Never store secrets in arguments.

save_account.description: Save a real application account reference using its opaque account key. The application retains encrypted sessions; plugin edits preserve remembered local profiles. Identity cannot be rebound.

save_profile.description: Save reusable launch settings. Cindy desktop uses a persistent isolated data profile that can hold real accounts; acceptance requires debugPort. Each computer signs in separately.

save_case.description: Save ordered acceptance actions and expected outcomes. Saving does not run a test.

remove.description: Remove a catalog entry only. Dependencies must be reassigned first; application data and credentials remain.

import_cindy.description: Remember all accounts saved in this plugin job’s owned Cindy app, using the app account-sync interface. Optionally choose jobId; otherwise exactly one live job must match the project. Never copies credentials or scans daily-host profiles.

plan.description: Preview commands and the complete start/select-account/prepare-samples/execute-cases/stop workflow without execution. Mobile uses Baguette. No missing client WIP flags are passed.

start.description: Start a saved profile action and return a persistent jobId. Cindy acceptance automatically remembers app-saved real accounts, selects the requested saved identity once and verifies online authentication. Missing/expired local login waits for normal sign-in. Samples and cases still need real execution; never repeat start while waiting.

status.description: Read jobs, account observation and online identity verification. Ready means the account and app are usable, not that samples or acceptance cases passed. Unknown requires inspecting the exact instance.

stop.description: Stop only this job and its verified owned process. Preserve every app-saved account, encrypted session, data and plugin account history. Does not log out. Query until stopped.

inspect.description: Inspect only this job’s owned desktop app through its local debug port, even while locked. Return projected login state, remembered-account count and optional private screenshot. Never return tokens, cookies, raw auth state or another app.

select_account.description: Request switching the exact owned live Cindy acceptance job to a remembered real account from the same project. Returns requested, not success. The app must have its own login on this computer; uncertainty never triggers an automatic repeat. Query status and inspect before explicitly requesting another switch. Does not export credentials.
